description: This file contains authentication dependency functions for a FastAPI application, specifically to retrieve the current user and admin user based on OAuth2 Bearer tokens. It interacts with the database models User and AdminUser to fetch user data.

methods.name: User get_current_user( db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), )
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user based on the bearer token. Raises HTTP 401 if token is invalid, payload is missing 'sub', or user is inactive.

methods.name: AdminUser get_current_admin( db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), )
methods.description: Returns the current admin user if token has admin privileges. Raises HTTP 401 if token is invalid or user not found, HTTP 403 if missing admin claim.

ctags.name: get_current_admin
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), )

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), )
